issues.description: The problem specification (UML and text) requires calculateRemainingOrderNumber() to return an int (number of remaining orders). The provided solution implementation declares calculateRemainingOrderNumber() as void and prints order numbers instead of returning a value. This return-type mismatch (int vs void) is likely to confuse students and will make automated tests or expected behavior inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the specification. Change the method signature in SealSaloon.java to public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber() and have it return the number of remaining orders (e.g., return this.orders.length). Remove or separate any printing logic so the method's purpose is to return the integer as specified. Alternatively, if printing is the intended behavior, update the problem statement and UML to declare the method as void and document the printing behavior.
